items.caption: This seal-script-style drawing shows 看 as a hand-like shape above an eye-like shape, illustrating the received Shuowen analysis.
items.alt: A black seal-script-style figure resembling a hand above an eye on a white background.
items.selection_reason: The visible forms make the traditional 手-over-目 analysis legible and help explain the received interpretation. This is a modern digital drawing, not a dated inscription.

limitations.text: The image illustrates a received seal-script form but cannot establish 看’s appearance or development in securely dated early inscriptions; the hand-shading interpretation remains unconfirmed by such evidence.
